notes.title: Some improvements and issues regarding game features
notes.content:
The updated content is as follows:

1 ：
Fixed an issue where some players may crash in full screen mode of the game

2 ：
The game's ability to modify graphics quality has received some new features!
Now you can customize your game graphics by using the image quality configuration function at the bottom of the startup menu!

This time it can be considered as improving this feature, there may have been some issues before

3：
A better solution has been obtained regarding the issue of game resolution

If you have a 2K, 4K, or 8K monitor and exit the game, do you find that the desktop icon has become smaller?
This is normal because the game automatically sets the picture quality based on your desktop resolution and zoom, so this situation may occur

The automatic setting of game graphics is to adapt to display devices with 1920 * 1080 resolution and lower resolution as much as possible
So players with 2K or higher resolution monitors can exit the game and select the "Restore Desktop Zoom" option in the startup menu to restore the settings

what? Can't find this startup item?
Please open the image quality configuration function in the startup option and customize the desktop zoom function here!

We have no choice but to redefine the game in this way, as we want to preserve the original art style while also maintaining high graphics quality and refresh rate

Thank you for your support and understanding,
Wishing you a happy life and enjoyable gaming!

4：
The game strategy has been improved, and now it seems even more perfect than before!
Perhaps compared to game feature updates, this is nothing,
But the improvement of game strategy can enable more friends to directly solve some difficult and unfamiliar problems!
For novice novices, it is also a way to relieve stress! Don't worry about any more problems!

Do you seem to have a better answer?








Considering the issue of some players experiencing lag? We would like to make a special note here!

You should carefully choose high-quality images! Because under the premise of enabling the highest image quality, your computer graphics card model must be at least GTX 1060 6G or above
See clearly, it is the minimum configuration requirement to enable the highest image quality! As for the rest, you can freely adjust the settings you think are most comfortable to play the game!
If the configuration is not sufficient, forcibly enabling the highest graphics quality may cause the game to crash or lag! This is your own problem, not related to the game!

5：
If you still encounter a situation where you cannot open the game after this update? Or other questions?
So we suggest that you uninstall the game directly and download and install it again to solve the problem!

6：
If the above does not solve your problem, you can think for yourself whether the game or Steam platform has been installed in the Chinese directory,
Example: C: \ Program Files (x86) \ Teams\
D: Files with Chinese names \ Teams\
E: Files with Chinese names \ Teams\
F: Files with Chinese names \ Teams\
G: Files with Chinese names \ Teams\
H--------- Z: \ Chinese name file \ Teams\

If the installation directories listed above are all incorrect!
Think about why the same problem occurs when playing any game? Even occasional intermittent problems?

There is only one answer, the game installation directory is incorrect!
(If the installation directory is fine, then your system is incorrect. If you are installing a pure official Windows system)
There are absolutely no such strange problems!

7：
The installation guide (below is the correct installation directory for the game) includes the correct installation directory for your Steam platform!
